issue: XM parser requires241 instrument-header bytes even when sample count0 uses only29 core bytes.

primary_reference.scope: loadInstrHeader zero-initializes metadata,reads declared shorter header,and allocates sample structures only for positive sample count.

matrix: Six authored short-header cases,two full-header controls,four malformed refusals. Positive gates cover metadata/PCM,actual worker seek/EOF and resource bounds.
qualification: No container production change or accepted ID. Existing refusal baseline must be replaced only after positive acceptance gates pass.
before_scope: The normal Cargo baseline passes two refusal/control tests and ignores three intended acceptances. Forced metadata/PCM and worker acceptance decode the authored video then fail during XM source admission at the241-byte requirement. The worker does not start before this parse failure;no independent pre-fix seek failure is claimed.
implementation: Validate29-byte core and declared file span first. Short headers require sample count0;skip declared padding and supply neutral metadata equivalent to full empty headers. Nonzero samples still require extended fields;full-header behavior and resource accounting remain intact.
